name: 和风朱绿
description: 日式和纸米底 #FBF6E7 + 朱红 #C93756 + 墨绿 #3F6A4E 双色对冲。Hiragino Mincho 明朝体，H1 上下 4px 朱红粗线夹持、H2 墨绿文字+左 6px 朱红竖条、H3 朱红+虚墨绿底线、blockquote 朱红竖条+墨绿文字。留白大、双色强对比。适合日系/文化/生活美学/慢读内容。

styles.container: background-color: #FBF6E7; font-family: 'Hiragino Mincho ProN','Yu Mincho','Songti SC','Noto Serif JP',serif;
styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; color: #C93756; text-align: center; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 38px; margin-bottom: 28px; border-top: 4px solid #C93756; border-bottom: 4px solid #C93756; letter-spacing: 3px;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #3F6A4E; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 34px; margin-bottom: 18px; padding-left: 18px; border-left: 6px solid #C93756; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #C93756; line-height: 1.55; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #3F6A4E; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-style: italic; color: #3F6A4E; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 10px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 2px solid #C93756;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #3F6A4E; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.h6: font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #6A6253; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #2A241F; line-height: 2; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 5px solid #C93756; background: transparent; font-size: 16px; color: #3F6A4E; line-height: 1.9; font-style: italic;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 16px; color: #3F6A4E; line-height: 1.9; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.5px; background: transparent; font-style: italic;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 0; display: block; border: 1px solid #3F6A4E; background: transparent; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; height: 1px; width: 35%; background: #C93756; border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(201,55,86,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(201,55,86,0.3); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 92%; color: #C93756; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.pre: background: #F3EDD9; border: 1px solid #3F6A4E; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; color: #2A241F; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 30px; background: #3F6A4E; color: #FBF6E7; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #2A241F; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono',Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px;
styles.th: text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #FBF6E7; background: #3F6A4E; border-bottom: 3px solid #C93756;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #2A241F; line-height: 2; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes h2: font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; color: #3F6A4E; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #6A6253; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
